data.title: Sarut in charge after solid day at Bangkok Open
data.description: <p>Sarut Vongchaisit fired an eight-under-par 62 to take the third-round lead at the three-million-baht Singha Bangkok Open at Bangkok Golf Club in Pathum Thani yesterday.</p>

data.title: Sprinters strike gold at Track Asia Cup despite rain-shortened finals
data.description: Thailand's men's team sprint squad claimed gold at the Track Asia Cup 2026 yesterday, posting the fastest qualifying time before a violent downpour forced officials to abandon the final and decide medals on qualification times alone.

data.title: 'Raising the Game': Thai League 1 launches 30th anniversary season
data.description: Thailand's top football division marked three decades of existence on Friday, unveiling the 2026-27 Thai League season under the slogan "Raising the Game" as it seeks to push the domestic game closer to international standards.

data.title: Spikers earn  shot at 2028  Games spot
data.description: Thailand will have an opportunity to fight for an Olympic berth after booking their berth in the final of the 2026 AVC Women's Volleyball Asian Championship in Tianjin on Saturday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nico Carrillo posts negative anti-doping result after Superbon calls for drug test
data.description: Nico Carrillo has hit back at Superbon’s call for him to be drug-tested by publishing a ONE Championship letter stating that his latest in-competition anti-doping test returned a negative result.

data.title: Jai sets tone with opening day gold at Huamark track
data.description: <p>Thailand's Jai Angsuthasawit delivered a timely boost to the Kingdom's Asian Games medal hopes, edging out Australia's Xavier Bland in a thrilling keirin finish at the Track Asia Cup 2026 at Huamark Velodrome yesterday.</p>

data.title: Shock results rock every division of English game
data.description: <p>It may be a clich&eacute; that what makes football such a popular sport is its unpredictability, but this was very much in evidence last weekend in England when there were major upsets in every division, including wins for two newly promoted sides in the Premier League.</p>

data.title: Thailand draw Iraq, HK in U17 Asian Cup qualifiers
data.description: <p>Thailand have been drawn against Iraq, Hong Kong, Taiwan and the Maldives in Group B of qualifying for the AFC U17 Asian Cup Uzbekistan 2027.</p>

data.title: Thailand, Japan face off for final spot
data.description: <p>Defending champions Thailand will take on arch-rivals Japan in the semi-finals of the AVC Women's Volleyball Continental Championship 2026 at Tianjin Olympic Center Gymnasium today.</p>

data.title: Puripol fired up for gold after his European stint
data.description: <p>Puripol Boonson will shoulder Thailand's hopes for a gold medal at next month's Asian Games in Japan after the sprinter recorded impressive times during a training stint in Europe, said the Athletics Association of Thailand during the third session of the Meet the Press on Friday.</p>

data.title: 'Find your own room': Japan says can't handle added Asian Games numbers
data.description: TOKYO - Japanese organisers have told late additions to next month's Asian Games to find their own accommodation, saying they don't have the money or space to deal with ballooning participant numbers.

data.title: Arsenal face depleted Aston Villa, Spurs seek return on $408m spend
data.description: MANCHESTER — Arsenal are out to inflict more damage on a wounded Aston Villa, while Tottenham are desperate to see some return for their £300 million ($408 million) investment in new signings when Newcastle visit north London.

data.title: Uefa target Infantino for 'criminal mismanagement', suspend boycott threat
data.description: LAUSANNE - Embattled president of the International Federation of Association Football (Fifa), Gianni Infantino, was on Thursday potentially facing a legal suit brought by the Union of European Football Associations (Uefa) accusing him of "criminal mismanagement" over his now-shelved plan to bring private financing into the World Cup.

data.title: Arsenal face depleted Aston Villa, Spurs seek return on pound sterling300m spend
data.description: MANCHESTER - Arsenal are out to inflict more damage on a wounded Aston Villa, while Tottenham are desperate to see some return for their £300 million ($408 million) investment in new signings when Newcastle visit north London.

data.title: Thai aces too hot to handle in Tianjin
data.description: <p>Reigning champions Thailand advanced to the semi-finals of the AVC Women's Volleyball Continental Championship 2026 when they defeated South Korea 3-0 in Tianjin, China, yesterday.</p>

data.title: Kingdom wins praise from UCI officials, Korean team
data.description: <p>Thailand's organisation of the Track Asia Cup 2026 has won high praise from international cycling officials, with both the chief UCI commissaire and South Korea's Sangju Cycling team manager commending the event's standards across competition, logistics and hospitality.</p>

data.title: War Elephants' rally falls short in Hanoi
data.description: <p>Thailand's hopes of reclaiming the regional title slipped away in Hanoi on Wednesday night as they were held to a 2-2 draw by Vietnam in the second leg of the Asean Hyundai Cup 2026 final, losing 4‑2 on aggregate.</p>

data.title: Ruthless Bayern target treble as Bundesliga kicks off
data.description: BERLIN - Bayern Munich have vowed to pick up where they left off last season, targeting the treble, while their outclassed Bundesliga rivals have undergone a reboot to try and cut the gap.

data.title: UEFA set to withdraw Fifa boycott threat
data.description: MONACO - Thursday’s draw for this season’s Champions League has been somewhat overshadowed by the latest developments in the dispute between UEFA and Fifa over plans to bring private financing into the World Cup, with European football’s governing body expected to drop a threatened boycott of global competitions.

data.title: Mbappe hits treble as Real Madrid thrash Real Sociedad
data.description: MADRID - Kylian Mbappe scored a brilliant hat-trick to help Real Madrid thrash Real Sociedad 4-1 in La Liga in Jose Mourinho's first home match back at the Santiago Bernabeu as the club's coach.

data.title: Angels to challenge for every trophy
data.description: <p>Bangkok United head coach Totchtawan Sripan is satisfied with the club's off-season recruitment and is backing his team to do well in the upcoming Thai League 1 campaign.</p>

data.title: Thai sports action set for TV, online blitz
data.description: <p>Sport fans will be able to follow the competition and cheer on Thai athletes participating at the 20th Asian Games and the 5th Asian Para Games in Japan via digital TV channels and online platforms, it was confirmed on Wednesday.</p>

data.title: Opetaia embraces the heat in Phuket
data.description: <p>It has been an interesting few months for boxing in the Land of Smiles. With Tyson Fury recently bringing his own fight week to Pattaya, Thailand's boxing scene has felt particularly alive.</p>

data.title: Pakistan's girls fight for their place in the boxing ring
data.description: KARACHI - Sweat trickling down her face, aspiring teenage boxer Hoorain Zahra works on a punch combination, eager to follow in the footsteps of her idol Aliya Soomro.

data.title: High quality, low risk: record number of Japanese in Premier League
data.description: TOKYO — A record number of Japanese players are in England's Premier League this season, with clubs attracted by their proven quality, value for money and the "very little risk" involved in signing them.

data.title: Golf giant Callaway apologises after ad sparks outcry
data.description: LOS ANGELES — Golf equipment giant Callaway issued an apology on Tuesday for a now-cancelled advert, which showed a male golfer shoving a female player to the ground when she reaches for his new driver.

data.title: PGA chief says 'no current plans' for LIV stars to return
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - The PGA currently has no plans to offer LIV Golf stars like Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm a pathway back from the struggling breakaway tour, chief executive officer Brian Rolapp said on Tuesday.

data.title: Kingdom in QF as pool winners
data.description: <p>Defending champions Thailand dropped their first set but advanced to the quarter-finals of the AVC Women's Volleyball Continental Championship 2026 as pool winners after they defeated Kazakhstan 3-1 in Tianjin, China, yesterday.</p>

data.title: A train ride with a great who hated to fly
data.description: <p>This week I'm going back to a golfer that many readers probably won't ever have heard of. Neil Coles was a British professional golfer whom I met on a train heading from London in a southerly direction. I know who he was as I had watched him play many times live and on television. A quiet man who had the reputation of being the best fairway wood player, he won many events in his tournament career.</p>

data.title: No fear! Hudson tells Thais
data.description: <p>Thailand are facing a mountain to climb in Hanoi tonight but head coach Anthony Hudson has called on his players to show their bravery as the seven-time champions attempt to overturn Vietnam's 2-0 lead from the first leg of the Asean Hyundai Cup 2026 final.</p>
